plugin.description: A native MonkeyType practice calendar for your Noctalia bar.
plugin.name: MonkeyType Activity

ape_key.description: Create a key in MonkeyType under Settings, then Ape Keys, and paste it here. Requests are sent with the key in a header, never in a command line.
ape_key.label: Ape Key

show_best_streak.description: Show the longest practice streak below the calendar.
show_best_streak.label: Show best streak

show_current_streak.description: Show the current practice streak below the calendar.
show_current_streak.label: Show current streak

show_last_test.description: Show the words per minute and accuracy of the last saved test.
show_last_test.label: Show last test

show_profile_button.description: Show the button that opens your MonkeyType profile in the browser.
show_profile_button.label: Show profile button

show_today.description: Show the test count for today below the calendar.
show_today.label: Show today's tests

show_year_total.description: Show the total number of tests for the selected view above the calendar.
show_year_total.label: Show view total

profile_username.description: Optional. Used for the profile button; the Ape Key already identifies your account.
profile_username.label: Profile username

refresh_interval.description: How often MonkeyType is checked. When nothing changed, only the cheap streak request runs.
refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval

widget_display_metric.description: Choose the value shown next to the keyboard icon.
widget_display_metric.label: Widget metric

widget_display_mode.description: Choose whether this widget shows only the keyboard icon or also a value.
widget_display_mode.label: Widget display

status.inactive_key: That Ape Key is disabled. Turn it on in MonkeyType's Ape Keys, or create a new one.
status.invalid_key: That Ape Key is not valid. Create a new one under Settings, then Ape Keys.
status.missing_xdg_open: xdg-open is required to open MonkeyType.
status.no_activity: No MonkeyType tests are saved on this account yet.
status.no_key: Add your MonkeyType Ape Key in the plugin settings.
status.rate_limited: MonkeyType rate limit reached. Retrying later.
status.refresh_schedule: Last updated at {time} · Auto-refresh every {interval} min
status.request_error: MonkeyType Activity could not reach the API.
